edge-validate-v1.description: Validate one graph edge given its evidence snippet (state).

edge_valid.instructions: Does the evidence in the state support the asserted relationship between the two entities?

rel_class.instructions: Which best describes the relationship given the evidence?

criteria.asserted: the asserted relationship type is correct
criteria.weaker_association: entities are associated but more weakly than asserted
criteria.different_relationship: a different relationship type fits better
criteria.unsupported: the evidence does not support any relationship

evidence_level.instructions: Rate the strength of the supporting evidence.

contradicted.instructions: Does the state contain evidence contradicting the asserted relationship?

edge-validate-v2.description: Validate one graph edge given its evidence snippet (state). v2: expert-revised ladder (Oct 2026) — splits supported into model-only vs patient, adds superseded detection for zombie knowledge.

edge_valid.instructions: Does the evidence in the state support the asserted relationship between the two entities?

rel_class.instructions: Which best describes the relationship given the evidence?

criteria.asserted: the asserted relationship type is correct

evidence_level.instructions: Rate the strength of the supporting evidence. A single case report is hypothesis-level. Replication in model organisms without any patient data is supported (model-only), never replicated: replicated means replicated in humans.

contradicted.instructions: Does the state contain evidence contradicting the asserted relationship?

superseded.instructions: Is the claim's key supporting evidence superseded: an older study, database annotation, or case report that newer, larger, or better-controlled evidence (cohort, replication, corrected localization) has overturned or undermined?

cluster-membership-v1.description: Judge whether two diseases plausibly share a mechanism, for cluster validation.

same_mechanism.instructions: Do these two diseases disrupt the same biological pathway or mechanism?

phenotype_informative.instructions: Is the phenotype overlap between the two diseases specific/informative rather than generic?
